note: BH-7659. The project lanes bin/project-lane-run.sh sheds while the hub is over, a comma or space list of lane ids (at most 64). The sampler reads settings row `hub_load.shed_lanes` first (the seed value catalog = no override), then this env value, then every lane with "sheds": true in catalog/lanes.d, then HLS_SPAWN_LANES. A list with a bad id is skipped. Set the row, not this knob: `bin/jobs-client.sh setting-set hub_load.shed_lanes "alert-triage,blocked-resolver" "why"`.
